description: This file defines a custom UI component SpeedPickerLayout for Wear OS applications, representing an item in a wearable list with visual state changes based on focus position.

classes.name: SpeedPickerLayout
classes.description: A custom LinearLayout subclass implementing WearableListView.OnCenterProximityListener to handle visual updates when the item gains or loses focus.

methods.name: SpeedPickerLayout(Context)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the layout with a context.

methods.name: SpeedPickerLayout(Context, AttributeSet)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the layout with a context and attribute set.

methods.name: SpeedPickerLayout(Context, AttributeSet, int)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the layout with context, attribute set, and style.

methods.name: onFinishInflate()
methods.description: Called after inflation to get references to child views (circle and name).

methods.name: onCenterPosition(boolean)
methods.description: Updates UI to indicate the item is centered (focused).

methods.name: onNonCenterPosition(boolean)
methods.description: Updates UI to indicate the item is not centered (not focused).
